import pygame
import music21
from pydub import AudioSegment

class MelodyMaker:
    def __init__(self):
        self.interface = pygame.display.set_mode((800, 600))
        self.notes = []
        self.styles = []
        self.instruments = []

    def select_note(self):
        # Display a list of available notes
        notes = music21.note.Note('C4')
        notes.duration.quarterLength = 1
        self.interface.blit(notes, (100, 100))

    def change_duration(self):
        # Allow user to change the duration of a selected note
        duration = 1
        self.interface.blit(pygame.font.Font(None, 36).render(str(duration), True, (255, 255, 255)), (100, 150))

    def arrange_sequence(self):
        # Allow user to arrange notes in a sequence
        sequence = music21.stream.Stream()
        sequence.append(music21.note.Note('C4'))
        sequence.append(music21.note.Note('D4'))
        self.interface.blit(sequence, (100, 200))

        # Load a pre-set musical style from the library
        style = music21.style.Style('style1')
        self.interface.blit(style, (100, 250))

    def load_instrument(self):
        # Load a pre-set instrument from the library
        instrument = music21.instrument.Instrument('instrument1')
        self.interface.blit(instrument, (100, 300))

    def copy_note(self):
        # Copy a selected note
        note = music21.note.Note('C4')
        self.notes.append(note)

    def paste_note(self):
        # Paste a copied note
        note = self.notes[-1]
        self.interface.blit(note, (100, 350))

    def delete_note(self):
        # Delete a selected note
        self.notes.pop()
